messages:
sam_sales: Heads-up: Aurelius wants a slimmed-down capability matrix + redacted sample inference logs for their procurement packet. They also want a firm POC quote for a 10-day Dedicated trial with 3k tokens/day baseline. Uploaded the vendor doc to the drive: https://drive.redwood.com/aurelius/request_v3.xlsx

tara_se: I'll take the capability matrix and the perf rows. Quick Q: which model variant should we show in the matrix? They asked for the 'best cost/latency' option.

anil_security: I'll do logs + security Q. For logs, we should redact user text but include token counts, model id, latency, and route. I'll paste a sample redaction pattern in a sec. Also need confirmation on whether audits include request-level metadata for Dedicated.

joni_fin: I'll price the 10-day trial. Rough calc: Dedicated s1-small day rate = $950/day with baseline infra + support, plus token charge. For 10 days @3k tokens/day that looks like ~$11.5k, but need final sign-off from finance.

sam_sales: Can we get a draft number today? Procurement wants a line item breakdown (compute, support, extras). If finance needs more context, I'll loop them in.

tera_se: (typo) Tara here — suggested model: RedPose-13B-quant (s1-small profile) — it's the cost/latency sweet spot for 512 seq typical loads. I'll add a note about quantization impacts on logits calibration.

anil_security: Sample redacted log format (will put in drive under /aurelius/logs_redacted.txt):

```
2026-03-18T14:02:11Z | request_id=req_8a12 | model=RedPose-13B-quant | profile=s1-small | tokens_in=48 | tokens_out=92 | p50_ms=210 | p99_ms=395 | route=embed-service | user_id=redacted | prompt_hash=sha256:xxxx
2026-03-18T14:02:16Z | request_id=req_8a13 | model=RedPose-13B-quant | profile=s1-small | tokens_in=128 | tokens_out=256 | p50_ms=230 | p99_ms=410 | route=chat-service | user_id=redacted | prompt_hash=sha256:xxxx
```

I'll redact PII and remove raw text fields. Also note: logs are exportable to S3 and we can send a sample bundle with obfuscated text.

deploy-bot: Reminder: RFC deadline for capability matrix is 2026-03-19T20:00Z. Please tag with #aurelius when uploaded.

sam_sales: Legal wants to see SCCs + short POC SOW. Tara, can you include an explicit note in the matrix about supported contractual flows (SCC, DPA) for hosting modes?

tara_se: Yep. I'll add a row: "Contracts supported" -> Hosted: SCCs/DPA, Dedicated: SCCs/DPA, Private: DPA + customer-managed controls. Also will include a footnote for on-prem: "on-prem requires licensed bundle and onsite engineer".

anil_security: FedRAMP question: we don't have a FedRAMP authorization. I'll state that clearly and suggest FedRAMP roadmap if they require it — link to roadmap doc. Also including answer for KMS: Dedicated/Private support customer KMS via standard integrations + offline import for air-gapped.

joni_fin: For the quote I'll break it down: compute (10 * $950), support (flat $1,200), tokens (10 * 3k * $0.0008), engineering onboarding (one-time $2,000). Draft total: $10,500 + $1,200 + $24 + $2,000 = $13,724 (rounded to $13,750). Sending draft to finance for approval.

sam_sales: Solid. Once finance approves I'll add a short SOW and send to Aurelius. Can someone attach the sample redacted logs + matrix to the drive and ping procurement?

tara_se: Uploading matrix now and adding a "limitations" cell for sequence length vs p95 tradeoffs. Link: https://drive.redwood.com/aurelius/capability_matrix_v3.xlsx #aurelius

anil_security: Uploaded redacted logs bundle and an example IAM policy snippet to the same folder. Policy snippet: `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-logs/*"}]}`

deploy-bot: File uploaded by tara_se: capability_matrix_v3.xlsx at 2026-03-18T15:12:30Z

sam_sales: Great work — let's aim to have the finalized matrix + logs + POC quote by EOD so I can schedule the procurement review tomorrow morning. If any blocker escalate to me. :thumbsup:
